text: I am writing to respectfully request the placement of a temporary school crossing guard at the intersection of Warden Avenue and Freeman Street. The school parent community has continued to raise serious concerns about safety at this intersection. The location was flagged by residents as having an accident in previous years, in addition to this crossing being a main pedestrian pathway for students leaving Birchcliff Public School. Parents and school staff report that driver behaviour, including aggressive driving and failure to yield, further increases the risk for children and families walking to and from school. Given these ongoing concerns, and in light of the unique design and operating conditions at this intersection, I am requesting that Scarborough Community Council override the technical analysis and authorize the placement of a temporary school crossing guard at Warden Avenue…

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services, to install a temporary school crossing guard at the intersection of Warden Avenue and Freeman Street until a subsequent warrant analysis can be conducted by the end of the fourth quarter of 2026.
